{{Youmay|the Southern Ocean on [[Kathol (disambiguation)]]|the [[Southern Ocean (Kalimahr)|ocean]] on [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]] or the [[Southern Ocean]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]}}
The '''Southern Ocean''' was one of four major bodies of [[Water/Legends|water]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. It was bordered by the [[Central Wasteland]] and [[Southern Wasteland]], and flowed into the [[Triad Sea]].
